run_open_close_drawer_test: run the script to open and close a drawer using SpotSkillManager with ROS parameters
run_spot_skill_manager_init: run the SpotSkillManager initialization and configure ROS parameters for skill execution
run_opendrawer_method: run the opendrawer method on SpotSkillManager to open a drawer on the Spot robot
run_closedrawer_method: run the closedrawer method on SpotSkillManager to close a drawer on the Spot robot
run_llm_planner_instruction: run the script to set an LLM planner instruction via rospy for navigation and pick-place tasks
